subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Opaque
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1) **i.e. 'Intelligible'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Opaque : (अपारदर्शी) **- Not able to be seen through; not transparent.

 
 
• **Example:** The windows were opaque with steam.
 
 
 
• **Intelligible : (सुस्पष्ट) **- Able to be understood; clear enough to be read, heard, etc.
 
 
• **Example: **His instructions were not intelligible.
 
 
 
• From the above example, it can be stated that **Intelligible **is the most appropriate **antonym **for **Opaque**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Intelligible'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explore the other options:
 
 
• **Transient : (अस्थायी) **- Passing with time; not permanent.

 
 
• **Example: **Our happiness was transient and soon replaced by hardship.
 
 
 
• **Volatile : (परिवर्तनशील)** - Likely to change rapidly and unpredictably, especially for the worse.
 
 
• **Example:** The political situation was becoming more volatile.
 
 
 
• **Conventional : (परंपरागत)** - Based on or in accordance with what is generally done or believed.
 
 
• **Example:** He had conventional manners and wore conventional clothes.
 
 
 
 

10d:Taf4,

The correct answer is 'Option 4'<
